verdict.rationale: Warp's own docs say users can prompt the agent in natural language, type '#' to describe a command and get it generated, and hand the built-in agent a task to plan and execute. Community users corroborate AI-generated commands and asking the agent to find and assess old files. Missing for 10: consistent independent evidence of reliable natural-language execution, since one Pro user reports random agent failures and stopping, and the '#' Generate feature is now marked Legacy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: You can prompt the agent in natural language, review and approve its actions, and run shell commands in the same input
Generate (Legacy) turns natural language queries into precise terminal commands or contextual suggestions inside interactive CLI tools.
Describe what you want to build and let Warp's built‑in agent handle the rest — writing code, running commands, and iterating until the task is done.
Type '#' on your command line and start describing the command you want to run using natural language.
